_note: Green authority is narrow here on purpose. Agents may extend the exam;
they may not touch the index write path or the ranking code. Ranking is
the highest-blast-radius code in the product and has no cheap oracle, so
it stays core (AMBER) rather than being given a weak check.
The same reasoning governs quotelint. Adding a way to test the judge is
green; moving a bar the judge reads is not, because every headline number
the subsystem reports is a function of those bars and the temptation to
tune them until the report looks good is the failure mode this whole

red.reason: index sync, snapshot resolution and the tier lane; repaired once already and not re-opened to agents
the frozen baseline is the exam; recall is always reported against it as well as against the extended set

the judging thresholds. Every headline number is a function of these, so an agent that could move them could make any report say anything. Threshold changes go through a human with the control-set result attached.
supervisor instructions; a reviewer that can edit what it is reviewed against is not a reviewer

zones.serves: OPTIMISE — the exam gets harder as the corpus grows

zones.serves: OPTIMISE — the control set only measures failure modes it can produce
zones.note: Adding a mutation family makes the exam harder and can only lower the recall number, so it is the one edit here that cannot flatter the report.

zones.serves: OPTIMISE — who investigates this subsystem, and what they are asked
